dct_description_sm: This new product will present data for specific census topics and population groups according to selected demographic, cultural, and socio-economic characteristics. These detailed 'profile-type' tables expand the analytical depth of basic census information. Special interest profiles include: ethnic groups, Aboriginal peoples, occupation, industry, and place of work.
